name: staff-profile-enum-contract
title: Fix staff profile GraphQL enum serialization
description: Restore the manager staff list by aligning lowercase staff persistence enums with the uppercase GraphQL contract at the shared resolver boundary.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The manager staff-list failure is caused by missing GraphQL enum internal-value mappings. The database and DTO correctly return lowercase values such as monthly, while StaffSalaryType exposes uppercase enum names. The shared resolver contract and a focused executable-schema regression test are in PR #1362. Automated tests were not run locally because the GitHub connector has no runnable checkout; task remains in progress pending CI.
